# Vellora

> Vellora is a multi-vendor marketplace for thoughtfully made products — electronics, home goods, stationery, and sustainable lifestyle essentials from independent sellers. Buy directly from trusted vendors with fast shipping, easy returns, and real customer reviews.

## About Vellora

- [Vellora homepage](http://localhost:3000/): Multi-vendor marketplace for premium electronics, home & lifestyle goods, and sustainable essentials.
- [Browse all products](http://localhost:3000/products): Shop electronics, home decor, fashion, and more from independent vendors.
- [Explore stores](http://localhost:3000/stores): Discover the independent sellers behind every product.
- [About Vellora](http://localhost:3000/about): Our mission, values, and how the marketplace works.
- [Contact us](http://localhost:3000/contact): Get in touch with the Vellora team.
- [Careers](http://localhost:3000/careers): Join the Vellora team.
- [Terms of service](http://localhost:3000/terms): Terms and conditions for using Vellora.
- [Privacy policy](http://localhost:3000/privacy): How we collect and use data.

## Product categories

- **Electronics & tech**: Wireless headphones, mechanical keyboards, USB-C hubs, smart watches, and more.
- **Home & lifestyle**: Ceramic plant pots, soy candles, woven throws, bamboo desk organizers, and more.
- **Stationery & writing**: Linen notebooks, fountain pens, weekly planners, reading journals, and more.
- **Fashion & accessories**: Canvas totes, denim jackets, running sneakers, leather wallets, and more.
- **Fitness & wellness**: Yoga mats, adjustable dumbbells, insulated water bottles, and more.
- **Sustainable living**: Bamboo toothbrushes, beeswax food wraps, compostable phone cases, natural lip balm, and more.

## Frequently asked questions

- **What is Vellora?** Vellora is a multi-vendor marketplace where independent sellers offer quality products across electronics, home, lifestyle, and sustainable essentials.
- **How do purchases work?** Buy directly from a vendor; each order is fulfilled and shipped by the individual store.
- **Can I return a product?** Yes — every product includes a 30-day return window.
- **Do products come with a warranty?** Most products include a warranty; check the individual product page for details.
